verdict.rationale: Swell is a commerce platform that could plausibly add MCP-client support to its own AI features, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows Swell connecting to or consuming external MCP servers. The AI page (swell-docs-21) describes an external agent learning Swell's file contract and CLI, which is the opposite direction, and webhooks and functions are generic outbound integrations, not MCP-client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
